content.title: 2 Services Stocks Worth Investigating and 1 That Underwhelm
content.summary: Business services providers use their specialized expertise to help enterprises streamline operations and cut costs. These doubts have certainly contributed to services stocks’ recent underperformance - over the past six months, the industry’s 5.3% gain has fallen behind the S&P 500’s 11.7% rise.
